key.name: english-source
key.description: XKB layout id to switch to while the overview is open. Falls back to the first XKB source when the id is not configured.

key.name: restore
key.description: Switch back to the source that was active before the overview opened. A manual switch while the overview is open is never reverted.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log every switch decision to the journal.
